text: Made like any lactitol: lactose from whey permeate is hydrogenated over a nickel catalyst; the crystals are then packed as unit-dose sachets. Nothing further is done to the sugar alcohol.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: hydrogenate
steps.note: A lactose solution of about 30 % dry matter is hydrogenated over a Raney nickel catalyst at about 40 bar of hydrogen.

steps.name: crystallise
steps.note: The lactitol is crystallised, as the monohydrate or dihydrate.

links.name: US patent 6,090,429: Process for the manufacture of a lactitol syrup (background)

sources.text: The patent's background gives the industrial hydrogenation of lactose over Raney nickel at about 100 °C and 40 bar and says crystallisation is the hard part; Wikipedia that lactitol comes as anhydrous, monohydrate and dihydrate. The sachet packing is not sourced here.
